_coupling_mechanics.status: Proposed generative and computational law; not an established physical law, not the standard sphere S^8 without separate topological proof, and not evidence of physical quantum entanglement.
_coupling_mechanics.author: Russell Philip Smithson

canonical_terms.fifth_coordinate: elucidation coordinate t8 with declared independent semantic or mechanical meaning
canonical_terms.total_space: locally eight-dimensional noncollapsed penteract-S^3 hyperfiber system

equations.activation_score: h_i=beta(Mq+1/2-d_i)+a_E E_i+a_u u_i-a_chi chi_i-a_zeta zeta_i+J2*sum_j W_ij(2p_j-1)+J3*sum_{j,k} H_ijk(2p_j-1)(2p_k-1)

classification_order: UNRESOLVED when an uncertainty interval crosses a declared tolerance or required evidence/provenance is missing
HIGHER_ORDER when a triadic term changes the pairwise result
FIBER_STATE_RESONANT when delta8_ij<=tol8 and phase coherence is within tolerance
SEMANTIC_ONLY when latent and projected gaps are positive but gJ_ij<=tolJ
REINFORCING when semantics, phase, and provenance support the same result
relation_test.tol5: 1e-7 L unless a stricter profile is declared
relation_test.tol8: 1e-7 L unless a stricter profile is declared
relation_test.tol3: 1e-5 L unless a stricter rendering profile is declared
relation_test.observability: A single 3x5 base projection has nullspace dimension at least two; stacked views require rank 5 for unique linear center reconstruction.

r12_profile.projection_tests: g5, delta8, g3, gJ, projection version, tolerance profile
r12_profile.fold_invariant: document-level folding must preserve contradiction, uncertainty, provenance, projection version, and the interaction order that changed the result

execution_policy.escalation: activate triadic terms only in unresolved, contradictory, high-risk, or certification-critical clusters
execution_policy.complexity_target: O(Nk) pairwise sparse execution with selective higher-order escalation rather than unrestricted O(N^3) triads

validation_gate.compare_models: fit M7 and M8 to the same data and evaluate held-out results

_coupling_mechanics.example: When g5>tol5 and g3<=tol3, record PROJECTION_ONLY; preserve delta8, gJ, uncertainty, projection version, and interaction order independently.
annotations: The fifth coordinate is admitted only when it contains a material residual outside span(C4), has declared meaning, and improves held-out efficacy after compute and energy costs.
A five-dimensional base plus an S^3 fiber gives local noncollapsed dimension 8, but does not by itself prove the total space is the standard sphere S^8.
Increasing latent dimension is distinct from adding higher-order coupling: H_ijk is required for genuine triadic mechanics.

Additional numerical data required: C4, proposed coordinate e, G5, W, optional H, evidence fields, phase initial conditions, projection family, apparent radii or meshes, semantic metric, tolerances, provenance, and replay identifier.
